title: Weather Report Annotated Discography: 8:30 (1979)
notes: The live sides mostly from the Terrace Theater, Long Beach, November 1978 (the page gives the 24th and the 28th); side four in the studio, Pastorius on drums for "8:30" and "Brown Street". Erskine quoted: Black Market "is not edited to the best of my knowledge"; on Birdland, he first "played it like Alex [Acuña] did on Heavy Weather", then "I came up with the shuffle idea, though I wasn't convinced that it was such a great idea."

title: Peter Erskine, Percussive Arts Society Hall of Fame
notes: Began at four, lessons from Johnny Civera; at the Stan Kenton summer camps studied with Louis Hayes, Charlie Perry, Ed Soph and Alan Dawson; occasional lessons with George Gaber at Indiana University; left IU for Kenton, then in 1976 for Maynard Ferguson; Pastorius recommended him for Weather Report; his first Grammy for 8:30; five years with Steps Ahead. "I had been listening a lot to Miles Davis, the Mahavishnu Orchestra, and Weather Report" (1983); "it was as natural to embrace Count Basie as to embrace James Brown"; "He can hit hard and aggressively, and he can play softly and with sensitivity." Modern Drummer readers' Best Jazz Drummer ten times, its Hall of Fame 2017; Berklee honorary doctorate 1992.

title: Weather Report - Wikipedia
notes: Pastorius helped recruit Erskine in 1978; a quartet without a percussionist in 1978-79, all four doubling on percussion live; Erskine a full member from the Mr. Gone tour to 1982, when Word of Mouth and Steps Ahead took him and Omar Hakim came in; Erskine back on This Is This! (1986) and in Weather Update.

title: Mr. Gone (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Personnel: Erskine drums on tracks 1 and 7 (The Pursuit of the Woman with the Feathered Hat, Pinocchio) and hi-hat on 3; Pastorius drums on 1-2; Tony Williams on 5-6 (Mr. Gone, Punk Jazz); Steve Gadd on 3 and 8. Erskine "would become Acuña's replacement".

title: Weather Report, Rockpalast, Stadthalle Offenbach, September 1978 (concert film)
notes: The full concert for WDR's Rockpalast, Zawinul, Shorter, Pastorius and Erskine. Set and times as uploaded: Black Market 0:00, Scarlet Woman 11:03, ... Teen Town 1:15:19 (8:08), Birdland 1:32:16 (6:59), Erskine's solo "Fred & Jack" 1:40:52. The upload says 29 September; a retailer's notes say the 28th. Watched for the likeness (Birdland, 1:33:06 to 1:33:46).
